baseline.name: WarmCopyRegion
baseline.boundary: One complete public CopyRegion from the resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster: source x127,y65,w256,h129 to x17,y19 in a separate caller-owned 513x259 canvas at the same depth. Admission, validation, cooperative cancellation checkpoints and operation-scope cleanup are included. Native public FFmpeg av_image_copy_plane mutates the equivalent borrowed canvas. Source/canvas preparation, reset, IPC, startup, I/O and verification excluded equally; identical overwrites are idempotent, with no reset between operations. No output allocation or full-frame copy on either subject. Exact full canvas, alpha, hidden RGB, untouched pixels and unchanged source. One CPU, normal SIMD; only this rectangle is measured.
